audioRequiredUz: 12a-mashqda 'listen to Madame Annette' deyilgan, lekin AUDIO KERAK EMAS: oltala gapning javobi shu betdagi BOSILGAN bashoratlardan so'zma-so'z tekshiriladi. Har bir javobning asosi whyUz da ko'rsatilgan.
scanNote: 13-mashq (Speaking) va Writing loyihasi kitobning oxiridagi 'Photo File' bo'limiga tayanadi — bu bo'lim bizdagi skanda YO'Q. Shuning uchun quyida topshiriqning TUZILISHI, qoliplari va shu betdagi 12 bashorat asosidagi namuna berilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: The twelve star signs and their horoscopes
exercises.instructionUz: O'n ikki burj va ularning bashoratlari
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N IKKI BURJ (star signs) VA SANALARI:

  Aries       (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19)  — Qo'y
  Taurus      (Apr. 20 - May 21)   — Buzoq
  Gemini      (May 22 - June 21)   — Egizaklar
  Cancer      (June 22 - July 22)  — Qisqichbaqa
  Leo         (July 23 - Aug. 23)  — Arslon
  Virgo       (Aug. 24 - Sept. 23) — Parizod
  Libra       (Sept. 24 - Oct. 23) — Tarozi
  Scorpio     (Oct. 24 - Nov. 22)  — Chayon
  Sagittarius (Nov. 23 - Dec. 21)  — Yoy
  Capricorn   (Dec. 22 - Jan. 20)  — Echki
  Aquarius    (Jan. 21 - Feb. 18)  — Qovga
  Pisces      (Feb. 19 - Mar. 20)  — Baliqlar


HAMMA BASHORATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  TAURUS (Apr. 20 - May 21)
  This will be an EXCITING week. You'll RECEIVE a
  letter from a friend. At the weekend you'll get
  a special INVITATION. ACCEPT it.

  GEMINI (May 22 - June 21)
  This will be a difficult week. You'll ARGUE WITH
  your best friend. Don't worry — you'll soon be
  friends again.

  CANCER (June 22 - July 22)
  You'll go on a long JOURNEY this week. You'll
  enjoy yourself a lot, but don't drive too fast.

  LEO (July 23 - Aug. 23)
  You'll get some good NEWS in a letter, and
  you'll HAVE A LOT OF FUN on Saturday.

  VIRGO (Aug. 24 - Sept. 23)
  You'll have problems with someone in your
  family. Don't worry — everything will be okay
  soon.

  LIBRA (Sept. 24 - Oct. 23)
  This will be a PLEASANT week. You'll go on a
  short TRIP and you'll have lots of fun.

  SCORPIO (Oct. 24 - Nov. 22)
  You will lose some money on Tuesday. A friend
  will bring you some good news. You'll get an
  invitation at the weekend. Don't accept it.

  SAGITTARIUS (Nov. 23 - Dec. 21)
  This will be a HORRIBLE week. There will be bad
  news on Wednesday and you'll have problems with
  someone in your family. The weekend will be
  better.

  CAPRICORN (Dec. 22 - Jan. 20)
  This won't be a good week for you. You'll have
  problems with your HEALTH. Try to relax.

  AQUARIUS (Jan. 21 - Feb. 18)
  This will be your LUCKY week. You will get a lot
  of money. You'll get an invitation at the
  weekend. Accept it.

  PISCES (Feb. 19 - Mar. 20)
  This will be a bad week. You will have problems
  with your health. Try to rest during the
  weekend. Things will be better next week.

  ARIES (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19)
  It will be a pleasant week for you. You'll meet
  an interesting person and you'll get a lot of
  invitations. Enjoy yourself.


ENG MUHIM GRAMMATIK KUZATUV:
  HAMMA bashorat 'WILL' bilan yozilgan —
  chunki bular BAShORAT (predictions), dalilga
  asoslanmagan (95-betdagi qoida).

  Uchraydigan shakllar:
     'This WILL BE ...'      (tasdiq)
     'You'LL get ...'        (qisqargan: you will)
     'This WON'T be ...'     (inkor: will not)
     'THERE WILL BE bad news' (there will be + OT)
     'IT WILL BE a pleasant week' (it will be)

  Va BUYRUQ gaplar:
     'ACCEPT it.'    'DON'T ACCEPT it.'
     'DON'T WORRY.'  'TRY to relax.'
     'ENJOY yourself.'


DIQQAT — 95-BETDAGI QOIDA ShU YERDA IShLAYAPTI:
  'It WILL BE a pleasant week' — 'pleasant' SIFAT
     → IT will be
  'THERE WILL BE bad news' — 'news' OT
     → THERE will be
  Bitta istisno ham yo'q.

sentences.en: TAURUS (Apr. 20 - May 21): This will be an exciting week. You'll receive a letter from a friend. At the weekend you'll get a special invitation. Accept it.
sentences.uz: BUZOQ (20-apr — 21-may): Bu qiziqarli hafta bo'ladi. Do'stingdan xat olasan. Dam olish kunlari maxsus taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN so'zlar: exciting, receive, invitation, Accept.
'receive' = olmoq (= get, lekin rasmiyroq).
'accept' = qabul qilmoq (aksi: 'refuse').

sentences.en: GEMINI (May 22 - June 21): This will be a difficult week. You'll argue with your best friend. Don't worry — you'll soon be friends again.
sentences.uz: EGIZAKLAR (22-may — 21-iyun): Bu qiyin hafta bo'ladi. Eng yaqin do'sting bilan janjallashasan. Xavotir olma — tez orada yana do'st bo'lasizlar.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN: argue with.
'argue WITH sb' = kimdir bilan janjallashmoq.
DIQQAT: predlog WITH.

sentences.en: CANCER (June 22 - July 22): You'll go on a long journey this week. You'll enjoy yourself a lot, but don't drive too fast.
sentences.uz: QISQICHBAQA (22-iyun — 22-iyul): Bu hafta uzoq safarga chiqasan. Juda zavqlanasan, lekin tez haydama.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN: journey.
'a journey' = safar (uzoq).
'go ON a journey' — predlog ON.
'enjoy YOURSELF' — o'zlik olmoshi.

sentences.en: LEO (July 23 - Aug. 23): You'll get some good news in a letter, and you'll have a lot of fun on Saturday.
sentences.uz: ARSLON (23-iyul — 23-avg): Xatda yaxshi yangilik olasan va shanba kuni juda ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazasan.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN: news, have a lot of fun.
'news' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot ('a news' XATO).
'have fun' = ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazmoq.

sentences.en: VIRGO (Aug. 24 - Sept. 23): You'll have problems with someone in your family. Don't worry — everything will be okay soon.
sentences.uz: PARIZOD (24-avg — 23-sent): Oilangdagi kimdir bilan muammoing bo'ladi. Xavotir olma — tez orada hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.
sentences.noteUz:
'have problems WITH sb' — predlog WITH.
'everything' — BIRLIK → 'will be'.

sentences.en: LIBRA (Sept. 24 - Oct. 23): This will be a pleasant week. You'll go on a short trip and you'll have lots of fun.
sentences.uz: TAROZI (24-sent — 23-okt): Bu yoqimli hafta bo'ladi. Qisqa sayohatga chiqasan va juda ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazasan.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN: pleasant, trip.
'pleasant' = yoqimli.
'a trip' = qisqa sayohat ('a journey' — uzoq).
'lots of fun' = 'a lot of fun'.

sentences.en: SCORPIO (Oct. 24 - Nov. 22): You will lose some money on Tuesday. A friend will bring you some good news. You'll get an invitation at the weekend. Don't accept it.
sentences.uz: CHAYON (24-okt — 22-noy): Seshanba kuni bir oz pul yo'qotasan. Do'sting senga yaxshi yangilik keltiradi. Dam olish kunlari taklif olasan. Uni qabul qilma.
sentences.noteUz:
'lose money' = pul yo'qotmoq.
DIQQAT: Taurus va Aquarius 'ACCEPT it' deydi,
Scorpio esa 'DON'T ACCEPT it' — TESKARI.

sentences.en: SAGITTARIUS (Nov. 23 - Dec. 21): This will be a horrible week. There will be bad news on Wednesday and you'll have problems with someone in your family. The weekend will be better.
sentences.uz: YOY (23-noy — 21-dek): Bu dahshatli hafta bo'ladi. Chorshanba kuni yomon yangilik bo'ladi va oilangdagi kimdir bilan muammoing bo'ladi. Dam olish kunlari yaxshiroq bo'ladi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN: horrible.
'horrible' = dahshatli (juda yomon).
'THERE WILL BE bad news' — 'news' OT → THERE.
'BETTER' — 'good' ning qiyosiy shakli.

sentences.en: CAPRICORN (Dec. 22 - Jan. 20): This won't be a good week for you. You'll have problems with your health. Try to relax.
sentences.uz: ECHKI (22-dek — 20-yanv): Bu sen uchun yaxshi hafta bo'lmaydi. Sog'ligingda muammo bo'ladi. Dam olishga harakat qil.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN: health.
'won't' = 'will not' — INKOR.
'health' = sog'liq (SANALMAYDIGAN).
'try TO relax' — 'try to + fe'l'.

sentences.en: AQUARIUS (Jan. 21 - Feb. 18): This will be your lucky week. You will get a lot of money. You'll get an invitation at the weekend. Accept it.
sentences.uz: QOVGA (21-yanv — 18-fev): Bu sening omadli hafting bo'ladi. Ko'p pul olasan. Dam olish kunlari taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN: lucky.
'lucky' = omadli.
Yagona bashorat 'a lot of MONEY' haqida —
12b-mashqning 4-savoli uchun.

sentences.en: PISCES (Feb. 19 - Mar. 20): This will be a bad week. You will have problems with your health. Try to rest during the weekend. Things will be better next week.
sentences.uz: BALIQLAR (19-fev — 20-mart): Bu yomon hafta bo'ladi. Sog'ligingda muammo bo'ladi. Dam olish kunlari dam olishga harakat qil. Keyingi hafta hammasi yaxshiroq bo'ladi.
sentences.noteUz:
'health' — Capricorn bilan bir xil mavzu
(12b-mashqning 3-savoli).
'during' = ... davomida.
'next week' — 'the' YO'Q.

sentences.en: ARIES (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19): It will be a pleasant week for you. You'll meet an interesting person and you'll get a lot of invitations. Enjoy yourself.
sentences.uz: QO'Y (21-mart — 19-apr): Bu sen uchun yoqimli hafta bo'ladi. Qiziqarli odam bilan uchrashasan va ko'plab takliflar olasan. Zavqlan.
sentences.noteUz:
'IT will be a pleasant week' — 'pleasant' SIFAT
→ IT (95-betdagi qoida).
'invitationS' — KO'PLIK (12b, 2-savol).
'Enjoy yourself' — buyruq + o'zlik olmoshi.

exercises.instructionEn: Which month were you born in? What is your star sign? Read the sentences, then listen to Madame Annette and write T (for true) or F (for false).
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi oyda tug'ilgansiz? Burjingiz qaysi? Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng Madam Annetni tinglang va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP — HAR BIRI BITTA BURJ HAQIDA.

DIQQAT — AUDIO KERAK EMAS:
  Oltala javob ham shu betdagi BOSILGAN
  bashoratlardan so'zma-so'z tekshiriladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Taurus: This will be a difficult week.   F
  2  Cancer: You'll go on a short journey.    F
  3  Leo: You'll get some good news in a
     letter.                                 T
  4  Libra: This will be a bad week.          F
  5  Capricorn: This won't be a good week
     for you.                                T
  6  Aquarius: This will be your lucky week.  T

  T — UCHTA:  3, 5, 6
  F — UCHTA:  1, 2, 4


HAR BIRI QANDAY TEKShIRILADI:

  1  Gap: 'This will be a DIFFICULT week.'
     Bashorat: 'This will be an EXCITING week.'
     → F. ('difficult' — bu GEMINI ning so'zi!)

  2  Gap: 'You'll go on a SHORT journey.'
     Bashorat: 'You'll go on a LONG journey.'
     → F. ('short' — bu LIBRA ning so'zi!)

  3  Gap: 'You'll get some good news in a letter.'
     Bashorat: 'You'll get some good news in a
     letter.'
     → T. SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil.

  4  Gap: 'This will be a BAD week.'
     Bashorat: 'This will be a PLEASANT week.'
     → F. ('bad' — bu PISCES ning so'zi!)

  5  Gap: 'This won't be a good week for you.'
     Bashorat: 'This won't be a good week for you.'
     → T. SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil.

  6  Gap: 'This will be your lucky week.'
     Bashorat: 'This will be your lucky week.'
     → T. SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil.


NAQSh — KITOB QANDAY ALDAYDI:
  Uchala 'F' bandida kitob BOShQA burjning
  so'zini olib qo'ygan:
     'difficult' — aslida Gemini niki
     'short'     — aslida Libra niki
     'bad'       — aslida Pisces niki

  Uchala 'T' bandida esa so'zma-so'z ko'chirilgan.

  Ya'ni: gapdagi SIFATNI bashoratdagi sifat bilan
  solishtirish yetarli.


BURJINGIZNI ANIQLASh:
  Tug'ilgan oyingiz va kuningizga qarab
  yuqoridagi sanalar ro'yxatidan toping.
  Masalan: 15-avgust → LEO (July 23 - Aug. 23).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a star sign = burj
  a horoscope = munajjimlar bashorati
  Madame     = xonim (fransuzcha murojaat)

items.sentence: Taurus: This will be a difficult week.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
Taurus bashorati: 'This will be an EXCITING
week.' — QIZIQARLI, qiyin emas.
DIQQAT: 'difficult' so'zi aslida GEMINI ning
bashoratida bor ('This will be a difficult
week').

items.sentence: Cancer: You'll go on a short journey this week.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
Cancer bashorati: 'You'll go on a LONG journey
this week.' — UZOQ safar, qisqa emas.
DIQQAT: 'short' so'zi aslida LIBRA ning
bashoratida bor ('a short trip').

items.sentence: Leo: You'll get some good news in a letter.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI (T).
Leo bashorati SO'ZMA-SO'Z shunday:
'You'll get some good NEWS in a letter, and
you'll have a lot of fun on Saturday.'

items.sentence: Libra: This will be a bad week.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
Libra bashorati: 'This will be a PLEASANT week.'
— YOQIMLI, yomon emas.
DIQQAT: 'bad' so'zi aslida PISCES ning
bashoratida bor ('This will be a bad week').

items.sentence: Capricorn: This won't be a good week for you.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI (T).
Capricorn bashorati SO'ZMA-SO'Z shunday:
'This WON'T be a good week for you. You'll have
problems with your health.'

items.sentence: Aquarius: This will be your lucky week.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI (T).
Aquarius bashorati SO'ZMA-SO'Z shunday:
'This will be your LUCKY week. You will get a lot
of money.'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the horoscopes and answer the questions. For some questions, there is more than one correct answer.
exercises.instructionUz: Bashoratlarni o'qing va savollarga javob bering. Ba'zi savollarda bittadan ortiq to'g'ri javob bor.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SAVOL: 'Which horoscope says ...?'
(Qaysi bashoratda shunday deyilgan?)

DIQQAT — KITOB OGOHLANTIRADI:
  'For some questions, there is MORE THAN ONE
   correct answer.'
  Ya'ni ba'zi savollarda BIR NEChTA javob bor.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  you'll receive a letter from a friend?
     →  TAURUS                       (kitob bergan)

  2  you'll get an invitation/invitations?
     →  TAURUS, SCORPIO, AQUARIUS, ARIES  (TO'RTTA)

  3  you'll have health problems?
     →  CAPRICORN, PISCES                 (IKKITA)

  4  you'll get a lot of money?
     →  AQUARIUS                          (BITTA)

  5  you'll have problems with someone in your
     family?
     →  VIRGO, SAGITTARIUS                (IKKITA)


HAR BIRI QAYERDAN:

  1  TAURUS: 'You'll RECEIVE A LETTER FROM A
     FRIEND.'
     DIQQAT: Leo da ham xat bor, lekin u
     'get some good news IN A LETTER' —
     do'stdan xat OLISh emas.
     Scorpio da esa 'A FRIEND will BRING you some
     good news' — xat emas.

  2  TAURUS:   'you'll get a special INVITATION'
     SCORPIO:  'You'll get an INVITATION at the
                weekend'
     AQUARIUS: 'You'll get an INVITATION at the
                weekend'
     ARIES:    'you'll get a lot of INVITATIONS'
     → TO'RTTA bashorat.
     DIQQAT: savolda 'invitation/invitationS' —
     kitob ataylab ikkala shaklni bergan, chunki
     Aries da KO'PLIK.

  3  CAPRICORN: 'You'll have problems with your
                HEALTH.'
     PISCES:    'You will have problems with your
                HEALTH.'
     → IKKITA bashorat, deyarli bir xil so'zlar.

  4  AQUARIUS: 'You will get A LOT OF MONEY.'
     → FAQAT BITTA.
     DIQQAT: Scorpio da pul bor, lekin
     'You will LOSE some money' — YO'QOTASAN,
     olmaysan. Bu TESKARI.

  5  VIRGO:       'You'll have problems with
                  SOMEONE IN YOUR FAMILY.'
     SAGITTARIUS: 'you'll have problems with
                  SOMEONE IN YOUR FAMILY.'
     → IKKITA bashorat, so'zma-so'z bir xil.


ENG ALDAMChI NUQTALAR:

  1-SAVOL: Uchta bashoratda 'letter' yoki 'friend'
     bor, lekin faqat TAURUS da 'do'stdan XAT
     OLISh' bor.

  4-SAVOL: Scorpio da ham 'money' bor, lekin
     'LOSE money' (yo'qotmoq) — savolda esa 'GET
     money' (olmoq). TESKARI ma'no.


DIQQAT — TAKLIF QABUL QILISh:
  Uchta bashorat taklif haqida gapiradi, lekin
  maslahat HAR XIL:
     TAURUS:   'ACCEPT it.'        (qabul qil)
     AQUARIUS: 'ACCEPT it.'        (qabul qil)
     SCORPIO:  'DON'T ACCEPT it.'  (qabul qilma)
  Bu — 4-modulda o'rganiladigan 'accept/refuse
  invitations' ko'nikmasiga tayyorgarlik.

pairs.left: 1  you'll receive a letter from a friend?
pairs.whyUz:
KITOB BERGAN.
Taurus: 'You'll RECEIVE A LETTER FROM A FRIEND.'

DIQQAT — ALDAMChI:
  Leo da ham xat bor, lekin 'get some good news
  IN A LETTER' — do'stdan xat olish emas.
  Scorpio da 'A FRIEND will BRING you some good
  news' — xat emas.

TO'RTTA bashorat:
  TAURUS:   'you'll get a special INVITATION'
  SCORPIO:  'You'll get an INVITATION at the
             weekend'
  AQUARIUS: 'You'll get an INVITATION at the
             weekend'
  ARIES:    'you'll get a lot of INVITATIONS'

DIQQAT: savolda 'invitation/invitationS' —
kitob ataylab ikkala shaklni bergan, chunki
Aries da KO'PLIK.

IKKITA bashorat:
  CAPRICORN: 'You'll have problems with your
              HEALTH. Try to relax.'
  PISCES:    'You will have problems with your
              HEALTH. Try to rest.'

Ikkalasida ham maslahat berilgan:
'try to relax' / 'try to rest'.

pairs.left: 4  you'll get a lot of money?
pairs.whyUz:
FAQAT BITTA bashorat:
  AQUARIUS: 'You will get A LOT OF MONEY.'

DIQQAT — ALDAMChI:
  Scorpio da ham 'money' bor, lekin
  'You will LOSE some money on Tuesday' —
  YO'QOTASAN, olmaysan. TESKARI ma'no.

pairs.left: 5  you'll have problems with someone in your family?
pairs.whyUz:
IKKITA bashorat, so'zma-so'z bir xil ibora:
  VIRGO:       'You'll have problems with SOMEONE
                IN YOUR FAMILY.'
  SAGITTARIUS: 'you'll have problems with SOMEONE
                IN YOUR FAMILY.'

'have problems WITH sb' — predlog WITH.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, explain the words in bold.
exercises.explanationUz:
BASHORATLARDAGI QALIN SO'ZLAR —
HAMMASI TUShUNTIRILGAN.

Jami 13 ta so'z va ibora.

sentences.en: exciting  (Taurus)
sentences.noteUz:
'This will be an EXCITING week.'
= juda qiziqarli hafta.
DIQQAT: 'exciting' — NARSA haqida,
'excited' — ODAM haqida (hayajonlangan).
Unit 12 da ham uchragan.

sentences.en: to receive  (Taurus)
sentences.noteUz:
'You'll RECEIVE a letter.'
= 'You'll GET a letter', lekin RASMIYROQ.
Aksi: 'to send' (yubormoq).

sentences.en: an invitation  (Taurus)
sentences.noteUz:
'you'll get a special INVITATION'
Fe'li: 'to invite' (taklif qilmoq).
4-modulning ko'nikmalaridan biri:
'accept/refuse invitations'.

sentences.en: to accept  (Taurus)
sentences.noteUz:
'ACCEPT it.' = Uni qabul qil.
Aksi: 'to REFUSE' (rad etmoq).
DIQQAT: Scorpio da 'DON'T ACCEPT it' —
teskari maslahat.

sentences.en: to argue with sb  (Gemini)
sentences.noteUz:
'You'll ARGUE WITH your best friend.'
DIQQAT: predlog WITH.
Ot shakli: 'an argument' (janjal, bahs).

sentences.en: a journey  (Cancer)
sentences.noteUz:
'You'll go on a long JOURNEY.'
'go ON a journey' — predlog ON.
DIQQAT: 'a journey' — UZOQ safar,
'a trip' — QISQA sayohat (Libra da).

sentences.en: news  (Leo)
sentences.noteUz:
'You'll get some good NEWS in a letter.'
SANALMAYDIGAN ot: 'a news' XATO,
'some news' ✓.
Fe'l ham BIRLIKDA: 'The news IS good.'

sentences.en: to have a lot of fun  (Leo)
sentences.noteUz:
'you'll HAVE A LOT OF FUN on Saturday.'
'fun' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot.
'lots of fun' = 'a lot of fun' (Libra da).

sentences.en: pleasant  (Libra)
sentences.noteUz:
'This will be a PLEASANT week.'
= yoqimli, xush.
Aries da ham bor: 'It will be a pleasant week
for you.'

sentences.en: a trip  (Libra)
sentences.noteUz:
'You'll go on a short TRIP.'
DIQQAT: 'a trip' — QISQA,
'a journey' — UZOQ (Cancer da).
'go ON a trip' — predlog ON.

sentences.en: horrible  (Sagittarius)
sentences.noteUz:
'This will be a HORRIBLE week.'
= juda yomon.
'horror' (dahshat) so'zidan.
Aksi: 'wonderful', 'lovely'.

sentences.en: health  (Capricorn)
sentences.noteUz:
'You'll have problems with your HEALTH.'
SANALMAYDIGAN ot.
Sifati: 'healthy' (sog'lom).
Pisces da ham bor.

sentences.en: lucky  (Aquarius)
sentences.noteUz:
'This will be your LUCKY week.'
Ot shakli: 'luck' (omad).
Aksi: 'unlucky' (omadsiz).
Ravish: 'luckily' (omadga ko'ra).

exercises.instructionEn: Study the language key in the Photo File section, then ask your partner what his/her star sign is. Use the key to tell them their horoscope for next week.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi til kalitini o'rganing, so'ng sherigingizdan burji nima ekanini so'rang. Kalitdan foydalanib, ularga keyingi haftalik bashoratni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh:
  Bu mashq kitobning oxiridagi 'Photo File'
  bo'limidagi TIL KALITIGA tayanadi.
  Bizdagi skanda o'sha bo'lim YO'Q.

  Shuning uchun quyida:
    • savol-javob QOLIPLARI (bular umumiy —
      100% aniq)
    • SHU BETDAGI 12 bashorat asosidagi namuna
  berilgan.


SAVOL-JAVOB QOLIPI:

  SA: 'What's your star sign?'
      (Burjing qaysi?)
  SB: 'I'm (a) Leo.' / 'My star sign is Leo.'
      (Men Arslonman.)
  SA: 'When were you born?'
      (Qachon tug'ilgansan?)
  SB: 'On 15th August.'

  So'ng bashoratni aytasiz:
  SA: 'You'll get some good news in a letter, and
       you'll have a lot of fun on Saturday.'


BURJNI ANIQLASh QOLIPI:
  'If you were born between [sana] and [sana],
   you're (a) [burj].'
  Masalan:
  'If you were born between 23rd July and 23rd
   August, you're a Leo.'


NAMUNA DIALOG:

  SA: What's your star sign?
  SB: I'm a Capricorn.
  SA: Really? Then this won't be a good week for
      you. You'll have problems with your health.
      Try to relax!
  SB: Oh no! What about you? What's your star
      sign?
  SA: I'm an Aquarius.
  SB: Lucky you! This will be your lucky week.
      You'll get a lot of money and you'll get an
      invitation at the weekend. Accept it!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  SA: Burjing qaysi?
  SB: Men Echkiman.
  SA: Rostdanmi? Unda bu sen uchun yaxshi hafta
      bo'lmaydi. Sog'ligingda muammo bo'ladi.
      Dam olishga harakat qil!
  SB: Voy! Sen-chi? Sening burjing qaysi?
  SA: Men Qovgaman.
  SB: Omading bor ekan! Bu sening omadli hafting
      bo'ladi. Ko'p pul olasan va dam olish
      kunlari taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil!


DIQQAT — ARTIKL:
  'I'm A Leo.' / 'I'm AN Aquarius.'
  Unli tovush bilan boshlansa — 'an':
     an Aquarius, an Aries
  Undosh bilan — 'a':
     a Leo, a Capricorn, a Taurus

  Artiklsiz ham aytish mumkin:
  'My star sign is Leo.'


FOYDALI IBORALAR:
  What's your star sign?  = Burjing qaysi?
  When were you born?     = Qachon tug'ilgansan?
  Lucky you!              = Omading bor ekan!
  Oh no!                  = Voy!
  Really?                 = Rostdanmi?
  What about you?         = Sen-chi?

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the Photo File section to write next week's horoscopes. Decorate your project with the pictures of the star signs.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib keyingi haftalik bashoratlarni yozing. Loyihangizni burj rasmlari bilan bezating.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh:
  Bu loyiha kitobning oxiridagi 'Photo File'
  bo'limidagi ma'lumotga tayanadi — bizdagi
  skanda o'sha bo'lim YO'Q.

  Shuning uchun quyida SHU BETDAGI 12 bashorat
  asosida tuzilgan QOLIPLAR va NAMUNA berilgan.
  Bu qoliplar bilan istalgan bashoratni yozish
  mumkin.


BAShORAT YOZISh — TUZILISh:

  1) BURJ NOMI va SANALARI
     'Leo (July 23 - Aug. 23)'

  2) HAFTANING UMUMIY TA'RIFI
     'This will be a(n) [SIFAT] week.'
     yoki
     'It will be a [SIFAT] week for you.'

  3) IKKI-UCh BAShORAT
     'You'll [fe'l] ...'

  4) MASLAHAT (buyruq gap)
     'Accept it.' / 'Don't worry.' /
     'Try to relax.' / 'Enjoy yourself.'


FOYDALANISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN SIFATLAR:
  IJOBIY:  exciting, pleasant, lucky, wonderful,
           great, fantastic
  SALBIY:  difficult, bad, horrible, terrible


FOYDALANISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN BAShORATLAR:
  You'll receive a letter from a friend.
  You'll get an invitation.
  You'll go on a long journey / a short trip.
  You'll meet an interesting person.
  You'll get some good news.
  You'll get a lot of money.
  You'll lose some money.
  You'll argue with your best friend.
  You'll have problems with your health.
  You'll have problems with someone in your
  family.
  You'll have a lot of fun.


FOYDALANISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN MASLAHATLAR:
  Accept it.          (Qabul qil.)
  Don't accept it.    (Qabul qilma.)
  Don't worry.        (Xavotir olma.)
  Try to relax.       (Dam olishga harakat qil.)
  Try to rest.        (Dam ol.)
  Enjoy yourself.     (Zavqlan.)
  Don't drive too fast. (Tez haydama.)


TO'LIQ NAMUNA (o'zingiz yozganingizda
shu qolipdan foydalaning):

  ARIES (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19)
  This will be a wonderful week. You'll get some
  good news on Monday and you'll meet an
  interesting person at the weekend. Enjoy
  yourself!

  TAURUS (Apr. 20 - May 21)
  This won't be an easy week. You'll argue with
  someone at school, but don't worry — everything
  will be okay soon.

  GEMINI (May 22 - June 21)
  It will be a lucky week for you. You'll receive
  an invitation to a party on Friday. Accept it!

  CANCER (June 22 - July 22)
  This will be a busy week. There will be a lot of
  work, but you'll have a lot of fun at the
  weekend.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  QO'Y (21-mart — 19-aprel)
  Bu ajoyib hafta bo'ladi. Dushanba kuni yaxshi
  yangilik olasan va dam olish kunlari qiziqarli
  odam bilan uchrashasan. Zavqlan!

  BUZOQ (20-aprel — 21-may)
  Bu oson hafta bo'lmaydi. Maktabda kimdir bilan
  janjallashasan, lekin xavotir olma — tez orada
  hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.

  EGIZAKLAR (22-may — 21-iyun)
  Bu sen uchun omadli hafta bo'ladi. Juma kuni
  ziyofatga taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil!

  QISQIChBAQA (22-iyun — 22-iyul)
  Bu band hafta bo'ladi. Ish ko'p bo'ladi, lekin
  dam olish kunlari juda ko'ngilli vaqt
  o'tkazasan.


GRAMMATIK QOIDALAR — ESLATMA:

  1) HAMMA bashorat 'WILL' bilan
     (95-bet: bashorat uchun 'will').

  2) 'IT will be + SIFAT' / 'THERE will be + OT'
     'It will be a lucky week.' (sifat: lucky)
     'There will be a lot of work.' (ot: work)

  3) 'You'll' = 'You will' (qisqargan shakl).

  4) INKOR: 'This WON'T be ...' (= will not).

  5) MASLAHAT — BUYRUQ gap:
     tasdiq: 'Accept it.' 'Enjoy yourself.'
     inkor:  'Don't worry.' 'Don't accept it.'


BEZASH:
  Kitob har bir burjning RASMINI chizishni
  so'raydi. Shu betdagi rasmlarga qarang:
  buqa (Taurus), egizaklar (Gemini),
  qisqichbaqa (Cancer), arslon (Leo),
  tarozi (Libra), chayon (Scorpio),
  baliqlar (Pisces), qo'y (Aries) va h.k.

structure.heading: 1  BURJ NOMI va SANALARI
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  '[Burj nomi] ([boshlanish sanasi] -
   [tugash sanasi])'
Shu betdagi ro'yxatdan sanalarni oling.

structure.heading: 2  HAFTANING UMUMIY TA'RIFI
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  'This will be a(n) [SIFAT] week.'
  'It will be a [SIFAT] week for you.'
  'This won't be a [SIFAT] week.'  (inkor)

SIFATLAR: exciting, pleasant, lucky, wonderful,
difficult, bad, horrible.
DIQQAT: 'an' unli tovushdan oldin
('an exciting week').
structure.modelEn: This will be a wonderful week.

structure.heading: 3  IKKI-UCH BASHORAT
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  'You'll [fe'l] ... on [kun].'
  'There will be [OT] on [kun].'

Kunlarni qo'shing: on Monday, on Friday,
at the weekend.
DIQQAT: kun bilan 'ON', 'weekend' bilan 'AT'.
structure.modelEn: You'll get some good news on Monday and you'll meet an interesting person at the weekend.

structure.heading: 4  MASLAHAT (buyruq gap)
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  TASDIQ: 'Accept it.' 'Enjoy yourself.'
          'Try to relax.'
  INKOR:  'Don't worry.' 'Don't accept it.'

Buyruq gapda EGA YO'Q — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'l.

structure.heading: 5  YOMON HAFTA UCHUN NAMUNA
structure.guideUz:
Salbiy bashoratdan keyin DOIM tasalli beriladi —
shu betdagi Gemini, Virgo va Pisces
bashoratlaridagi kabi:
  'Don't worry — everything will be okay soon.'
  'Things will be better next week.'
  'The weekend will be better.'
structure.modelEn: This won't be an easy week. You'll argue with someone at school, but don't worry — everything will be okay soon.

structure.heading: 6  BEZASH
structure.guideUz:
Kitob har bir burjning RASMINI chizishni
so'raydi.
Shu betdagi rasmlarga qarang: buqa, egizaklar,
qisqichbaqa, arslon, tarozi, chayon, baliqlar,
qo'y va h.k.

patterns.formula: This WILL BE a(n) [sifat] week.   /   This WON'T BE a good week.
patterns.exampleEn: This will be an exciting week. This won't be a good week for you.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu qiziqarli hafta bo'ladi. Bu sen uchun yaxshi hafta bo'lmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bashoratning ochilish gapi.
'won't' = 'will not'.
Unli tovushdan oldin 'an'.

patterns.formula: You'LL + ASOSIY fe'l + ... + ON [kun] / AT the weekend.
patterns.exampleEn: You'll receive a letter from a friend. You'll get an invitation at the weekend.
patterns.exampleUz: Do'stingdan xat olasan. Dam olish kunlari taklif olasan.

patterns.formula: THERE WILL BE + OT.   /   IT WILL BE + SIFAT.
patterns.exampleEn: There will be bad news on Wednesday. It will be a pleasant week for you.
patterns.exampleUz: Chorshanba kuni yomon yangilik bo'ladi. Bu sen uchun yoqimli hafta bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
95-betdagi qoida bashoratlarda ISTISNOSIZ
ishlaydi: OT → THERE, SIFAT → IT.

patterns.formula: [Salbiy bashorat]. DON'T WORRY — everything will be okay soon.
patterns.exampleEn: You'll argue with your best friend. Don't worry — you'll soon be friends again.
patterns.exampleUz: Eng yaqin do'sting bilan janjallashasan. Xavotir olma — tez orada yana do'st bo'lasizlar.
patterns.explanationUz:
Salbiy bashoratdan keyin DOIM TASALLI beriladi.
Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius va Pisces
bashoratlarida shunday.

patterns.formula: What's your star sign?  —  I'm a/an [burj].
patterns.exampleEn: What's your star sign? — I'm an Aquarius.
patterns.explanationUz:
Unli tovush bilan boshlansa — 'an'
(an Aquarius, an Aries).
Undosh bilan — 'a' (a Leo, a Taurus).
